organization_text:
Ardook is an award-winning social enterprise in Yerevan, Armenia, expanding to Georgia. It employs mothers of children with disabilities, many of them single mothers, who wash and iron clothes professionally from home with equipment, training and support from Ardook, while couriers handle pickup and delivery. It serves individuals, hotels, restaurants, preschools and beauty salons, creating decent work and reducing inequalities (UN SDG 8 and 10) with eco-friendly reusable bags and recycled hangers.
